N: nimitta：As signifying the mental reflex-image occurring in meditation，this term，singly or in compounds （parikkamma- ，uggaha- ，patibhāga-n．），is found only in the Com．，Vis．M．，etc．The same holds good for kamma-nimitta ，gati-nimitta ．

nimitta：mark，sign； image； target，object； cause，condition．These meanings are used in，and adapted to，many contexts of which only the doctrinal ones are mentioned here．

1．'Mental （reflex-） image'，obtained in meditation．In full clarity，it will appear in the mind by successful practice of certain concentration-exercises and will then appear as vividly as if seen by the eye．The object perceived at the very beginning of concentration is called the preparatory image （parikamma-nimitta）．The still unsteady and unclear image，which arises when the mind has reached a weak degree of concentration，is called the acquired image （uggaha-nimitta）．An entirely clear and immovable image arising at a higher degree of concentration is the counter-image （paṭibhāga-nimitta）．As soon as this image arises，the stage of neighbourhood （or access） concentration （upacāra-samādhi） is reached．For further details，s．kasiṇa，samādhi．

2．'Sign of （previous） kamma' （kamma-nimitta） and 'sign of （the future） destiny' （gati-nimitta）； these arise as mental objects of the last karmic consciousness before death （maraṇāsanna kamma； s．kamma，III，3）．

Usages （1） and （2） are commentarial （s．App．）．In Sutta usage，the term occurs，e．g．as：

3．'Outward appearance'：of one who has sense-control it is said- that ＂he does not seize upon the general appearance' of an object （na nimittaggāhī； M．38，D．2； expl．Vis I，54f； see sīla）．

4．'Object'：the six objects，i．e．visual，etc．（rūpa-nimitta； S．XXII，3）．Also，when in explanation of animitta -cetovimutti，signless deliverance of mind （s．cetovimutti，vimokkha），it is said，'sabbanimittānaṃ amanasikārā'，it refers to the 6 sense-objects （Com．to M．43 [Saḷāyatanavagga-aṭṭhakathā]），and has therefore to be rendered ＂by paying no attention to any object （or object-ideas）．＂ - A pleasant or beautiful object （subha-nimitta，q．v．） is a condition to the arising of the hindrance of sense-desire； a 'repellent object' （paṭigha-nimitta） for the hindrance of ill-will； contemplation on the impurity of an object （asubha-nimitta； s．asubha） is an antidote to sense-desire．

5．In Pts．M．II，in a repetitive series of terms，nimitta appears together with uppādo （origin of existence），pavattaṃ （continuity of existence），and may then be rendered by 'condition of existence' （s．Path，194f．）．

(suññato vimokkho ~o vimokkho appaṇihito ~o … suññato samādhi ~o samādhi appaṇihito samādhi …; Sp 493, 25 : vimokkho … rāgadosamohehi suññattā suññato rāgadosamoha-nimittehi ~-ttā ~o rāgadosamohapaṇidhānaṃ abhāvato appaṇihito ti vuccati); V 221, 8 (~aṃ sīmaṃ sammannati); D II 100, 18 (yasmiṃ … samaye tathāgato sabbanimittānaṃ amanasikārā ekaccānaṃ vedanānaṃ nirodhā ~aṃ cetosamādhiṃ upasampajja viharati phāsukato … tasmiṃ samaye tathāgatassa kāyo hoti); III 249, 16 (~ā hi kho me cetovimutti bhāvitā … atha ca pana me nimittānusāri viññāṇaṃ hotī ti); M I 296, 32 foll. (dve … paccayā ~āya cetovimuttiyā samāpattiyā sabbanimittānaṃ ca amanasikāro ~āya ca dhātuyā manasikāro); 298, 23 (yāvatā kho āvuso ~ā cetovimuttiyo akuppā tāsaṃ cetovimutti aggam akkhāyati; Ps II 355, 6 foll. : ~ā cetovimuttiyo nāma terasa dhammā vipassanā cattāro āruppā cattāro maggā cattāri phalānī ti, tattha vipassanā niccanimittaṃ sukhanimittaṃ attanimittaṃ ugghāṭetī ti ~ā nāma, cattāro āruppā rūpanimittassa abhāvā ~ā nāma, maggaphalāni nimittakārakānaṃ kilesānaṃ abhāvena ~āni, nibbānaṃ pi ~am eva taṃ pana cetovimutti na hoti); III 107, 28 (bhikkhu … ~aṃ cetosamādhiṃ paṭicca manasikaroti ekattaṃ; Ps IV 153, 25 : vipassanācittasamādhiṃ, so hi niccanimittādivirahito ~o ti vuccati); 108, 15 (ayaṃ pi kho ~o cetosamādhi abhisaṅkhato abhisañcetayito, yaṃ kho pana kiñci abhisaṅkhataṃ abhisañcetayitaṃ tad aniccaṃ nirodhadhamman ti pajānāti); Dhp 93 (suññato ~o ca vimokkho yesaṃ gocaro; Dhp-a II 172, 7 foll. : tīṇi pi c’ etāni nibbānass’ eva nāmāni, nibbānaṃ hi … rāgādinimittābhāvena ~aṃ tehi ca vimuttan ti ~o vimokkho); Sn 574 (~aṃ anaññātaṃ maccānaṃ idha jīvitaṃ; Pj II 457, 15 : ~an ti kiriyākāranimittavirahitaṃ); Paṭis II 36, 10 (suññaṃ idaṃ attena vā attaniyena vā ti so tattha nimittaṃ na karotī ti ~o vimokkho; Paṭis-a 553, 18 : aniccānupassanāvasena niccanimittaṃ na karoti); Dhs 506 (paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati dukkhāpaṭipadaṃ dandhābhiññaṃ ~aṃ); Vism 236, 13 foll. (~ato ti avavatthānato paricchedābhāvato ti attho, sattānaṃ hi jīvitaṃ vyādhi kālo ca dehanikkhepanaṃ gati pañc’ ete jīvalokasmiṃ ~ā na ñāyare; cf 230, 25 : ~ato … maraṇaṃ anussaritabbaṃ) quoted Ja II 58, 9´ ; Vism 658, 14 (~o vimokkho ti animittākārena nibbānaṃ ārammaṇaṃ katvā pavatto ariyamaggo); 668, 26 (yasmā pan’ esa aniccānupassanāya saṅkhārānaṃ ghanavinibbhogaṃ katvā niccanimitta-dhuvanimitta-sassatanimittāni pajahanto āgato tasmā ~o); Kkh 2 7, 14 (~ā nāma yā [sīmā] sabbena sabbaṃ nimittāni akittetvā sammatā hoti) = Sp 1401, 21 ; Sv 1036, 24 foll. (~ā cetovimuttī ti arahattaphalasamāpatti, sā hi rāganimittādīnaṃ c’ eva rūpanimittādīnaṃ cābhāvā ~ā ti vuttā; cf Mp III 347, 17 foll: ~ā cetovimuttī ti balavavipassanā, dīghabhāṇakā pana arahattaphalasamāpattī ti vadanti); Spk III 90, 18 (niccasukha-attanimittānaṃ amanasikārena ~aṃ … cetosamādhiṃ); — animittaṃ karoti, does not mark or note or indicate ; Vin III 238, 37 (~aṃ katvā pātetabbaṃ; Sp 693, 7 : nimittaṃ akatvā … patitokāsaṃ asamannāharantena pātetabban ti attho); Kkh 2 125, 6 (tena ~aṃ katvā va gūthaṃ viya chaḍḍetabbaṃ); — ( ii ) w ithout pudenda ; Vin II 271, 17 (upasampannāyo dissanti ~ā pi nimittamattā pi …); III 129, 24 (akkosati nāma ~ā si nimittamattā si …; Sp 548, 14 foll. : ~ā sī ti nimittarahitā si … itthīpaṇḍakā ti ~ā va vuccati); — ( iii ) without undesirable characteristics ;? D III 146, 20 (so imaṃ paṭhaviṃ sāgarapariyantaṃ akhilaṃ ~aṃ akaṇṭakaṃ … abhivijiya ajjhāvasati; Sv 922, 6 foll. : niccoraṃ, corā hi … upaddavapaccayaṭṭhena nimittā … ti vuccanti); — 2. ( n. ) what is free from marks or attributes; of which nothing can be predicated ; S I 188, 23* (~aṃ ca bhāvehi; Spk I 272, 3 : niccādīnaṃ nimittānaṃ ugghāṭitattā vipassanā ~ā nāma) = Sn 342 ≠ Thī 105; Paṭis I 15, 6 (nimittaṃ saṅkhārā ~aṃ nibbānan ti abhiññeyyaṃ); 66, 20 (nimittaṃ abhibhuyyitvā ~aṃ pakkhandatī ti gotrabhū); Kv-a 180, 5 (~an ti sabbanimittarahitaṃ nibbānaṃ); — 3. ( mfn. ) without a reason or cause ; S V 213, 17 (taṃ ca ~aṃ anidānaṃ asaṅkhāraṃ appaccayaṃ dukkhindriyaṃ uppajjissatī ti n’ etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati); A I 82, 19 (sanimittā bhikkhave uppajjanti pāpakā akusalā dhammā no ~ā); — dunnimitta , n. , a bad omen; a sign of trouble ; Bv-a 288, 21 (idāni Māro āgamissatī ti paṭhamam eva anekarūpāni aniṭṭhāni ~āni pāturahesuṃ); Cp-a 93, 10 (ajja me dussupinaṃ diṭṭhaṃ ~āni ca uppannāni); — sanimitta , mfn. , 1. having a cause; arising from a cause ; S V 213, 16 (uppannaṃ kho me idaṃ dukkhindriyaṃ, taṃ ca kho ~aṃ sanidānaṃ sasaṅkhāraṃ sappaccayaṃ); A I 82, 18 (~ā bhikkhave uppajjanti pāpakā akusalā dhammā no animittā; Mp II 154, 2 : ~ā ti sakāraṇā); — 2. associated with attributes ;? As 223, 15 (vipassanā … nimittadhammesu caratī ti ~ā va hoti); — see also tannimittaka ( sv ta[d] ).

DOP: nimitta m.n. [ cf S., BHS nimitta], a sign, a mark; what one notes or marks ; 1. ( i ) a sign or mark by which something or someone is recognised or identified or known or defined; a distinguishing mark or appearance; a perceived (enduring) attribute, predicate (especially that of permanence); an attribution ; Abh 978 (~aṃ … lañchane); Vin I 106, 5 foll. (paṭhamaṃ ~ā kittetabbā pabbatanimittaṃ pāsāṇanimittaṃ vananimittaṃ … yāvatā samantā ~ā kittitā … saṅgho etehi ~ehi sīmaṃ sammanneyya samānasaṃvāsaṃ ekuposathaṃ); III 27, 25 (tehi ākārehi tehi liṅgehi tehi ~ehi vadati viññāpeti; Sp 254, 25 : sikkhāpaccakkhānassa sañjānanahetuto manussānaṃ tilakādīni viya ~ānī ti vuccati); IV 163, 32 (rūpena vā ~ena vā saññāṇaṃ katvā nikkhipitvā; Sp 882, 12 : ~an ti lañchanādi, tasmā lañchitāya bhaṇḍikāya mattikālañchanan ti vā lākhālañchanan ti vā nīlapilotikāya bhaṇḍikā katā ti vā … evamādi sabbaṃ sallakkhetabbaṃ); M I 360, 3 (te hi te gahapati ākārā te liṅgā te ~ā yathātaṃ gahapatissā ti; cf Ps III 38, 18 : ākārā ti ādīni sabbān’ eva kāraṇavevacanāni … gihibhāvassa sañjānananimittatāya ~ā ti vuttā); S V 150, 2 (akusalo sūdo sakassa bhattu ~aṃ na uggaṇhati idaṃ vā me ajja bhattasupeyyaṃ ruccati …); Nidd I 508, 24* (kālena kālaṃ cittassa ~am upalakkhiye); Paṭis I 10, 33 (uppādo abhiññeyyo pavattaṃ abhiññeyyaṃ ~aṃ abhiññeyyaṃ; Vism 649, 11 : ~an ti sabbaṃ pi saṅkhāranimittaṃ); II 42, 9 (~ato saññāya muccatī ti; Paṭis-a 559, 14 : ~ato ti ca niccanimittato); Mil 405, 17 (taṃ ārammaṇaṃ vaṇṇato ca … liṅgato ca ~ato ca daḷhaṃ patiṭṭhāpetvā); Vism 152, 26 (bhikkhū sīmaṃ bandhantā paṭhamaṃ ~āni sallakkhetvā pacchā bandhanti); 649, 24 (nibbatti jātī ti idaṃ hi dvayaṃ uppādassa c’ eva paṭisandhiyā ca vevacanaṃ, gati uppattī ti idaṃ dvayaṃ pavattassa, jarādayo ~assā ti); As 321, 8 (~an ti sañjānanaṃ); Mhv 15:192 (~e parikittiya); — ifc see khaṇḍa-, nicca-, sadda-, sukha-; — ( ii ) the organ of generation (of either sex), the pudenda ; Abh 273; 978 (~aṃ …vuttaṃ aṅgajāte); Vin III 28, 11 (yo ~ena ~aṃ aṅgajātena aṅgajātaṃ … paveseti); Sp 528, 5 (attano ~aṃ thaddhaṃ mudukan ti jānissāmī ti); — ifc see itthi-, purisa-; — ~aṃ karoti, makes a sign; marks; indicates; distinguishes ; Vin III 53, 12 foll. (~aṃ karoti akkhiṃ vā nikhaṇissāmi bhamukaṃ vā ukkhipissāmi … tena ~ena taṃ bhaṇḍaṃ avaharā ti); 56, 34 (aññataro bhikkhu divā bhaṇḍaṃ passitvā ~aṃ akāsi rattiṃ avaharissāmī ti); A III 110, 1 (oḷārikaṃ pi ~aṃ karissanti paṭhaviyā pi haritagge pi); Nidd I 355, 20 (ekaṃ ce tilaphalaṃ ~aṃ katvā tilavāhe pakkhipeyya taṃ yeva tilaphalaṃ uddhareyya; Nidd-a I 378, 3 foll. : sace ekatilabījaṃ saññāṇaṃ katvā); Ap 163, 4 (padumaṃ āhariṃsu me tathā ~aṃ katvā ’haṃ buddhassa abhiropayiṃ); Sp 353, 10 (aparo bhikkhuṃ pahiṇitukāmo ~aṃ karoti ko nu kho gahetvā gamissatī ti); 729, 10 (saññāṇaṃ katvā nikkhipitabban ti kiñci ~aṃ katvā ṭhapetabbaṃ); Ud-a 201, 20 (ayaṃ gāthā āyasmantaṃ Mahākassapaṃ ~aṃ katvā bhāsitā); — 2. an object or appearance or happening which is significant, which expresses more than itself ; ( i ) a sign, a significant appearance; an omen, a portent ; Vin I 343, 20 (tathā deva ~āni dissanti); D I 9, 4 (aṅgaṃ ~aṃ uppādaṃ supinaṃ …; Sv 92, 12 : ~an ti nimittasatthaṃ); 220, 32 (yathā ~ā dissanti āloko sañjāyati obhāso pātubhavati brahmā pātubhavissati); A I 170, 30 (ekacco ~ena ādisati evaṃ pi te mano itthaṃ pi te mano; Mp II 269, 4 : ~ena ādisatī ti āgatanimittena vā gatanimittena vā ṭhitanimittena vā idaṃ nāma bhavissatī ti katheti); Ja I 59, 31 (dīghabhāṇakā pan’ āhu cattāri ~āni ekadivasen’ eva disvā agamāsī ti); III 238, 20 (Darīmukho taṃ ~aṃ disvā ajja mayhaṃ sahāyo Bārāṇasiyaṃ rājā bhavissati ahaṃ senāpatī ti aññāsi); IV 482, 20 (ayaṃ daharakāle marissati ayaṃ mahallakakāle ti kassaci hatthe vā pāde vā ~aṃ natthi); Ap 18, 1 (uppātesu ~esu lakkhaṇesu ca kovidā; Ap-a 285, 8 : uppātesū ti ukkāpātadisāḍāhādi-uppātesu ca ~esū ti mūsika-cchinnādīsu); 158, 13 (jāyamāne Vipassimhi ~aṃ vyākariṃ ahaṃ … buddho loke bhavissati); Bv 2:35 (caturo ~e nāddasaṃ; Bv-a 84, 1 : caturo ~e ti cattāri ~āni); Mil 178, 18 (… uppādaṃ supinaṃ ~aṃ …); Ps IV 171, 1 (ukkāpātabhūmicālacandaggāhādīni ~āni); Mhv 22:70 (sabbaṃ ~aṃ disvāna); — ifc see pubba- ( sv pubba 2 ); — ( ii ) an indication, a hint ; D II 103, 10 (āyasmā Ānando bhagavatā oḷārike ~e kayiramāne oḷārike obhāse kayiramāne nāsakkhi paṭivijjhituṃ); Vibh 353, 1 (yaṃ paresaṃ ~aṃ °-kammaṃ obhāso obhāsakammaṃ sāmantajappā parikathā; Vism 28, 5 : ~an ti yaṃ kiñci paresaṃ paccayadānasaññājanakaṃ kāyavacīkammaṃ); Sv 563, 35 (oḷārikaṃ ~aṃ akāsiṃ taṃ pi tayā na paṭividdhaṃ); Ud-a 167, 26 (yaṃ kiñci ~aṃ dassetvā); — 3. ( i ) what one notes or marks; an object of thought or meditation or concentration; an image ; M I 119, 3 foll. (pañca ~āni kālena kālaṃ manasikātabbāni … yaṃ ~aṃ āgamma yaṃ ~aṃ manasikaroto uppajjanti pāpakā akusalā vitakkā … tamhā ~ā aññaṃ ~aṃ manasikātabbaṃ kusalūpasaṃhitaṃ; cf Ps II 87, 22 : ~ānī ti kāraṇāni); S I 188, 18* (~aṃ parivajjehi subhaṃ rāgūpasaṃhitaṃ) = Sn 341 = Th 1224 (Th-a III 192, 21 : ~an ti kilesajanakanimittaṃ); S V 156, 5 (tassa kismiñci-d-eva pasādanīye ~e cittaṃ paṇidahato pāmujjaṃ jāyati); Th 1105 (nibbajjayaṃ sabbasubhaṃ ~aṃ jhāne yuto); Paṭis I 164, 22 (~aṃ āvajjato assāse cittaṃ vikampati samādhissa paripantho; Paṭis-a 471, 19 : ~an ti assāsapassāsānaṃ phussanaṭṭhānaṃ); Vibh 193, 25 (idha bhikkhu ajjhattaṃ kāyaṃ … paccavekkhati atthi imasmiṃ kāye kesā … muttan ti, so taṃ ~aṃ āsevati bhāveti bahulīkaroti …; Vibh-a 260, 24 : so bhikkhu taṃ kammaṭṭhānanimittaṃ); Vism 155, 21 (tad eva ~aṃ paṭhavī paṭhavī ti punappunaṃ manasikaroto); 188, 28 (tass’ evaṃ paccavekkhato taṃ ~aṃ pākaṭaṃ hoti purato nikkhittaṃ viya upaṭṭhāti); 591, 8 (cakkhumato purisassa aparisuddhe ādāse mukhanimittaṃ olokentassa ~aṃ na paññāyati); — ifc see paṭigha-, mukha-, subha-; — ( ii ) an internal appearance or total awareness; a mental impression (appearing as an early stage of jhāna, a sign of progress ); A IV 418, 24 (ekacco bhikkhu bālo … akusalo … paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharituṃ, so taṃ ~aṃ na āsevati na bhāveti na bahulīkaroti …; Mp IV 194, 19 : taṃ paṭhamajjhānasaṅkhātaṃ ~aṃ); Mil 298, 3 (~aṃ etaṃ mahārāja supinaṃ nāma yaṃ cittassa āpāthaṃ upagacchati); Vism 112, 11 (thero pi aṭṭhikasaññāya lābhittā sabbadisāsu upaṭṭhitaṃ ~aṃ passanto kevalā pi paṭhavī aṭṭhikabharitā ti cintesī ti); 114, 4 (pubbabhāge cakkhunā oloketvā ~aṃ nesaṃ gahetabban ti attho); 123, 22 (tassa kir’ āyasmato kasitaṭṭhānaṃ olokentassa taṃ ṭhānappamāṇam eva ~aṃ udapādi); 135, 32* (paṭiladdhe ~asmiṃ appanā sampavattati); 150, 4 (paṭhavīmaṇḍalaṃ pana sakalaṭṭhena paṭhavīkasiṇan ti vuccati, taṃ nissāya paṭiladdhanimittaṃ pi paṭhavīkasiṇaṃ ~e paṭiladdha-jhānaṃ pi); 285, 5 (punappunaṃ kammaṭṭhānaṃ anuyuñjitabbaṃ, tass’ evaṃ anuyuñjato na cirass’ eva ~aṃ upaṭṭhāti); Spk III 175, 24 (aṭṭhikaṃ aṭṭhikan ti bhāventassa uppannasaññā, taṃ pan’ etaṃ bhāvayato yāva ~aṃ na uppajjati tāva chavi pi cammaṃ pi upaṭṭhāti); — ifc see uggaha-, paṭibhāga-, samatha-, samādhi-; — 4. a ground, a cause, a reason ; Abh 91 (~aṃ kāraṇaṃ ṭhānaṃ); 978; M I 72, 1 (tatra vata maṃ samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā … saha dhammena paṭicodessatī ti ~aṃ etaṃ Sāriputta na samanupassāmi); III 157, 27 (taṃ ca ~aṃ na paṭivijjhāmā ti; Ps IV 207, 13 foll. : taṃ ca kāraṇaṃ na jānāma); Mp I 32, 10 (~an ti paccayassa nāmaṃ); Ud-a 30, 34 (paresaṃ pucchāya vinā ajjhāsayam eva ~aṃ katvā desito parajjhāsayo); Nidd-a I 310, 15 (rūpam eva kilesānaṃ paccayatthena ~aṃ); Paṭis-a 315, 16 (nīvaraṇe ti °’-atthe bhumma-vacanaṃ, nīvaraṇanimittaṃ nīvaraṇapaccayā ti attho); Sadd 691, 2 (yaṃ … kiriyābhinipphattiyā ~aṃ taṃ vatthu kārakaṃ nāma bhavati); — ifc see tam- ( sv ta[d] ), tato-, yaṃ- ( sv ya[d] ); — nimittaṃ gaṇhāti, 1. marks, apprehends the characteristic features; apprehends an object or appearance (as distinguished in various ways); distinguishes, identifies an object or appearance ; Vin III 15, 32 (ñātidāsī … āyasmato Sudinnassa … hatthānaṃ ca pādānaṃ ca sarassa ca ~aṃ aggahesi; Sp 208, 27 foll. : gihikāle sallakkhitapubbaṃ ākāraṃ aggahesi sañjāni sallakkhesi); A III 423, 1 (eko paviveke anabhiramanto cittassa ~aṃ gahessatī ti n’ etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati);
